m.e: North Carolina will reward the men that led us to freedom, turn to them for leadership for a new country.

m.e: Good news is we made contact, so we can get to work.

m.t: Zdá se, že tu máme situaci s dobrou a špatnou zprávou.
m.e: Looks like we got a good news/bad news situation on our hands.

m.e: The good news is, that jerk who stood you up? He's gone.

m.t: Snad se vrátím s dobrou zprávou a plánem.
m.e: Hopefully I come back with good news and a plan.

m.e: The bad news is... that's not enough to win the election.

m.t: Tak je dobrou zprávou, že jsme něco našli.
m.e: Now the good news is, we found something.

m.e: I'm sorry; what does this have to do with the press release?

m.e: Good news is, I think that might have been the source of my other health problems.

m.t: Dobrou zprávou je, že existuje spousta osamělých mužů.
m.e: And the good news is, there's lots of lonely men.

m.t: Dobrou zprávou je, že rehabbed záda a teď se cítím skvěle.
m.e: The good news is, it rehabbed my back and now I feel great.

m.t: Dobrou zprávou je, že jsem našla Marcelovi přátele.
m.e: Good news is I found Marcel's friends.

m.t: Dobrou zprávou je, že tu zůstanu a najdu si tu pravou lásku mého života.
m.e: The good news is I'm going to stay here and find the true love of my life.

m.t: Dobrou zprávou je, že místo, kde začenete... je jenom začátkem.
m.e: The good news is is where you start... is just the beginning.

m.t: Špatnou zprávou je, že nemohou opustit základnu.
m.e: Bad news is, they won't let their guys leave the base.

m.t: Tam jsou, mé dvě oblíbené lidí, A s dobrou zprávou pro změnu.
m.e: There they are, my two favorite people, and with good news for a change.

m.t: Možná by mohl pomoct lékařskou zprávou.
m.e: Perhaps he can help with a medical note.

m.e: You want the good news or the bad news?

m.t: Ne, nejsem se svou zprávou spokojen!
m.e: No, I'm not satisfied with my message!

m.t: Dobrou zprávou je, že jsme zaneprázdněni.
m.e: The good news is that we were busy.

m.t: Špatnou zprávou je, že může regenerovat.
m.e: Bad news is it can regenerate.

m.t: Co je tou špatnou zprávou?
m.e: What's the bad news?

m.e: The bad news, no more guns.

m.t: Špatnou zprávou je, že e-mail se jít široký.
m.e: The bad news is that the email did go wide.

m.e: Until we hear otherwise, we're just gonna have to take no news as good news.

m.t: Dobrou zprávou je, že se hned můžete vrátit na vodu... a kázat dobré slovo.
m.e: Good news is that you can get right back out on the water... preaching the good word.

m.t: Myslím, že ta věc s podprahovou zprávou
m.e: I'm thinking the subliminal message thing

m.e: With my armies you can do whatever you like.

m.e: That is why I have placed you in command of our armies.

m.e: Even he would not lead his men against an army of 10,000.

m.e: I was away with the army during most of his childhood.

m.e: We just want to open channels, as we have with the German Army.

m.e: Or by the word of the conqueror of this island with an army of 100,000 souls behind his sword?

m.e: Someone with a large army, three large dragons, and no husband.

m.t: Představ si, co by mohli udělat s armádou zfanatizovaných rytířů.
m.e: Imagine what they could do with an army of brainwashed knights.

m.t: To budeš s armádou táhnout přes 3000 kilometrů?
m.e: You're going to march an army more than 2,000 miles?

m.e: You will have to rip me from this railing with a... An army of billionaires.

m.e: I assume you've come with the Jacobite army.

m.t: Jeď zpátky na jih s dokončeným úkolem a neporušenou armádou.
m.e: Ride south again with your mission complete and your army intact.

m.e: He's leaving with Malcolm Ariano and a small army.

m.e: What are you going to do with an army?

m.e: You arrived here with an army of your men.

m.e: Ford turned up with an army of suits.

m.t: S tak malou armádou?
m.e: With an army so small?

m.e: Shepherd is still out there with an army behind her, determined to strike... we need all the help we can get.

m.e: Now, please, bring out more wine and enjoy this feast.

m.e: I can get back to the party.

m.e: As soon as the sausage-fest is over, we can get back to some police work.

m.e: 'One last thing before you go to the party tonight, Governor.

m.e: Excited for tonight's gala?
